rows.text: Reflecting this growth outlook, early gains from our cost optimization program and our strong third-quarter performance, we raised our full year 2026 adjusted earnings per share guidance to $4.49 to $4.52, representing 15% to 16% growth over the prior year.
The Company’s fourth quarter adjusted diluted earnings per share guidance is in the range of $1.13 to $1.16 per share.
Reflecting this momentum and our strong first half performance, we increased our full-year adjusted earnings per share guidance to $4.35 to $4.43, representing 12% to 14% year-over-year growth.
The Company’s third quarter adjusted diluted earnings per share guidance is in the range of $1.06 to $1.09 per share.
